purpose: Independent, analyzer-only markers for when each frozen v1 bias-observability trajectory has delivered enough motion excitation to interpret convergence or right-censoring.

hover_axis_pulses.reason: The X, Y, and diagonal minimum-jerk corrections have completed, leaving a terminal observation window in the fixed-yaw hover profile.

takeoff_box_land.reason: The takeoff and N/E/S/W hover box have completed; the remaining descent, touchdown, and static dwell are retained for post-excitation observation.

yaw_quadrant_hover.reason: All four yaw quadrants have received the planned NED hover corrections; the final segment remains available for convergence observation.

negative_boundary: These markers do not prove observability, identify a unique excitation rank, or use truth to initialize the estimator. They only classify whether a measured convergence event occurred before or after a pre-declared motion milestone.
